title: Velocity selector direction
description: Essential: Correctly identifies the magnetic field direction in the velocity selector as perpendicular to the plane of the paper and outward.

title: Velocity from selector
description: Essential: States the particle velocity entering the D-shaped box as v = E/B.

title: Trajectory radius range
description: Important: Derives the allowed orbital radii range (5R/4 ≤ r ≤ 7R/4) from the D-shaped box geometry.

title: Magnetic field range derivation
description: Important: Applies Lorentz force as centripetal force (qvB₀ = mv²/r) to relate B₀ to radius, then uses radius limits.

title: Final B₀ range expression
description: Essential: Presents the final range as 4mE/(7qBR) ≤ B₀ ≤ 4mE/(5qBR).

title: Time for point M
description: Essential: Calculates the time to hit point M as half the period using the minimum B₀, giving t = 7πBR/(4E).

title: Sign confusion in force balance
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly determines the magnetic field direction in the velocity selector (e.g., inward instead of outward).

title: Radius misinterpretation
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect geometric limits for the orbital radius (e.g., R to 2R instead of 5R/4 to 7R/4).

title: Inverse relationship error
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly relates B₀ to radius (e.g., using B₀ ∝ r instead of B₀ ∝ 1/r).

title: Time period oversight
description: Pitfall: Calculates full period instead of half-period for the time to hit point M, or uses wrong B₀ value.
